identity: From *Warrior’s Guide*: Your badge isn’t your past; your orders come from the King.
From *Warrior Way Blog*: Identity fuels discipline—sons don’t earn a place; they operate from it.
hope: From *Grit & Grace (James)*: Trials don’t break you; they build endurance and crown wisdom.

prayers: King Jesus, speak into this moment. Give me wisdom pure and peaceable, steady my steps, and make me a peacemaker under Your command. Amen.

identity.txt: So you are no longer a slave, but a son... and if a son, then an heir through God.

hope.txt: I believe that I shall look upon the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living!
